title: Lightcoat
summary: Lightcoat is a defensive spell in the same vein as Honorguard that manifests through a pink aura.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
At the Professor's castle, Lightcoat was used by Sophie Casterwill to protect Sabriel against Zhalia Moon's King Basilisk while fighting about Dante Vale's choice to hand the Legendary Titans over to Simon Judeau. Though the shield was able to protect against King Basilisk's Stonegaze power, Zhalia's Titan was still able to destroy the shield to defeat Sabriel. [The Divine Comedy]

This spell subsequently was used by Sophie Casterwill to protect Sabriel against Simon's Nordrake during the ritual of the Legendary Titans. [The Mission]

full_text:
Lightcoat is a defensive spell in the same vein as Honorguard that manifests through a pink aura.

History

At the Professor's castle, Lightcoat was used by Sophie Casterwill to protect Sabriel against Zhalia Moon's King Basilisk while fighting about Dante Vale's choice to hand the Legendary Titans over to Simon Judeau. Though the shield was able to protect against King Basilisk's Stonegaze power, Zhalia's Titan was still able to destroy the shield to defeat Sabriel. [The Divine Comedy]

This spell subsequently was used by Sophie Casterwill to protect Sabriel against Simon's Nordrake during the ritual of the Legendary Titans. [The Mission]

International Names

French: Couvre-léger
Portuguese: Capa de Luz
